correctness.rationale: Exact executable enumeration returns 125 perfect matchings, 60,852 faces of P, 59,050 faces of auxiliary K; every face relation is checked. Checked elementary free-face collapses leave 714/484 total faces. Exact rational simplicial boundary ranks give beta_3(P)=beta_4(P)=2 and beta_4(K)=2, all other reduced Q betti zero. All 40 group actions preserve both complexes; two independent integer signed simplex algorithms agree for nine representatives. The Lefschetz class table matches four explicit one-dimensional characters, establishing the stated finite rational representation.

value.rationale: The ten-rung prism is the first nontrivial circular ladder where the known perfect-matching topology has positive reduced homology in two distinct degrees. Its two rank-two rational groups afford different one-dimensional D_10 x C_2 characters, including nontrivial layer-swap behavior in degree three and trivial behavior in degree four. The complete 16-class character distinguishes these natural invariant topological structures beyond face counts, Euler characteristic or nonequivariant Betti ranks.
